(1) the manner in which software developers are assigned to software tasks has an impact on the effort required to develop software; and (2) the impact of task assignment factors on the effort to develop a system is more important than the number of function points in the system.
task assignment patterns can be used to improve software effort estimation accuracy and a parsimonious model that utilizes task assignment factors and function points is superior to COCOMO.
